children: DataMeds AI entered into an Intellectual Property License and Product and Services Agreement with REBOOT Health AI to power its GLP-1 weight management platform. The exclusive U.S. license, limited to the company’s B2C GLP-1 use case, includes reconfiguration of the REBOOT platform as the DataMeds Platform and a revenue-sharing arrangement. Consideration includes 666,667 restricted shares valued at $2.0 million with a 180-day true-up, plus $50,000 toward reconfiguration work (minimum estimated cost of $100,000). The license runs until the last licensed patent expires and restricts source code access and modifications.
: Exclusive U.S. intellectual property license and platform services with revenue share
: Perpetual until last licensed patent expires
: Accelerate GLP-1 weight management platform with licensed AI technology

title: DataMeds AI Secures Exclusive U.S. License to REBOOT AI Platform; Issues $2M in Stock
